title: Sharp Bounds on the Winner's Bias under Independent and Nonnegatively Correlated Noise
abstract: arXiv:2610.31948v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reporting the best of $M$ noisy, unbiased scores overstates the winner's value by up to $c\sqrt{V}$, where $V$ is the total noise variance and the sharp constant $c$ depends on how the noise is dependent. It was known only at the two extremes, arbitrary dependence ($\sqrt{(M-1)/M}$) and i.i.d. noise. We determine it for two classes in between: for independent, not identically distributed noise it is $\sqrt{(M-1)/(2M)}$, and for pairwise nonnegatively correlated noise it is $(M-1)/M$; for uncorrelated noise this answers the maximum version of an open question about the expected range. Explicit finite constructions attain both. As a corollary, the bias of the cross-validation estimator is bounded sharply within each class. All theorems are formally verified in Lean 4. Across 448 language-model and classifier selection pipelines, designs with per-candidate items realize a median 0.75 of the independent-class ceiling. At a fixed item budget,

translated_title: 独立与非负相关噪声下赢家偏差的精确界
translated_abstract: 报告 $M$ 个含噪声、无偏分数中的最优值会使赢家价值被高估至多 $c\sqrt{V}$，其中 $V$ 是总噪声方差，精确常数 $c$ 取决于噪声之间的相关结构。此前该常数仅在两个极端情形下已知：任意相关（$\sqrt{(M-1)/M}$）和独立同分布噪声。本文确定了介于两者之间的两类情形：对于独立但非同分布的噪声，该常数为 $\sqrt{(M-1)/(2M)}$；对于两两非负相关的噪声，该常数为 $(M-1)/M$；对于不相关噪声，这一结果回答了关于期望极差的一个开放问题的最大值版本。文中给出了达到这两个界的显式有限构造。作为推论，交叉验证估计器的偏差在每个类别内都得到了精确界定。所有定理均在 Lean 4 中经过形式化验证。在 448 个语言模型和分类器选择流程中，采用按候选者分配条目的设计实现了独立类别上界的中位数 0.75。在固定条目预算下……
tldr: 本文精确确定了在独立非同分布噪声（$\sqrt{(M-1)/(2M)}$）与两两非负相关噪声（$(M-1)/M$）下，从 $M$ 个无偏含噪分数中选取最优值所导致的赢家偏差的紧致常数，给出了达到这些界的显式构造，所有定理经 Lean 4 形式化验证，并据此作为推论精确界定了交叉验证估计器的偏差。
